chunks: From him, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Ibn Bukayr, from 'Ubayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
My father (peace be upon him) disliked riding the sea for trade.

key_terms.يَكْرَهُ: he disliked / he held aversion to

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about sea travel for trade?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on earnings, this narration attributes to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) a specific dislike for maritime trade, reflecting the significant risks and uncertainties inherent in ancient sea voyages. This preference underscores a broader Shia jurisprudential caution toward high-risk commercial ventures, prioritizing stability and security in livelihood over potentially volatile maritime commerce.
